source: Dublin General Plan Land Use Element (Chapter 2, updated 2024), dublin.ca.gov/DocumentCenter/View/36593; Dublin Municipal Code Title 8 Zoning Ordinance, codepublishing.com/CA/Dublin

A.description: Agricultural Zoning District - very low density agricultural uses

R-1.description: Single Family Residential - lot size suffix determines density (e.g., R-1-10,000 to R-1-6,500); consistent with Low-Density Single-Family and Medium Density GP designations

R-2.description: Two Family Residential - duplexes and attached homes; lot size suffix determines density; consistent with Medium and Medium-High Density GP designations

R-M.description: Multi-Family Residential - apartments and condominiums; consistent with Medium-High Density GP designation (14.1-25.0 du/ac)

C-O.description: Commercial Office Zoning District - office and professional services; no residential

C-N.description: Neighborhood Commercial Zoning District - small-scale retail and services; no residential

C-1.description: Retail Commercial Zoning District - retail sales and services; no residential

C-2.description: General Commercial Zoning District - broad range of commercial uses; no residential

M-P.description: Industrial Park Zoning District - light industrial and office park; no residential

M-1.description: Light Industrial Zoning District - manufacturing and warehousing; no residential

M-2.description: Heavy Industrial Zoning District - heavy manufacturing and processing; no residential

PD.description: Planned Development Zoning District - density determined by approved PD plan; required for development over 6.0 du/gross acre

Downtown-Dublin-Village-Parkway.description: Downtown Dublin Specific Plan - Village Parkway District; mixed-use with FAR 0.35

Downtown-Dublin-Retail.description: Downtown Dublin Specific Plan - Retail District; mixed-use with FAR up to 2.5

Downtown-Dublin-Transit-Oriented.description: Downtown Dublin Specific Plan - Transit Oriented District; high-density mixed-use near BART with FAR 2.5

DC-MDR.description: Dublin Crossing Medium Density Residential - 6.0-14.0 units per net acre

DC-MHDR.description: Dublin Crossing Medium-High Density Residential - 14.1-25.0 units per net acre

GC-DC-MHDR.description: General Commercial / Dublin Crossing Medium-High Density Residential - mixed-use 14.1-25 du/ac with FAR 0.25-1.0

GC-DC-HDR.description: General Commercial / Dublin Crossing High Density Residential - 20.1-60 du/ac with FAR 0.25-1.0

Rural-Residential-Agriculture.description: Rural Residential/Agriculture - 1 unit per 100 acres; Western Extended Planning Area

Estate-Residential.description: Estate Residential - 0.01-0.8 du/ac; large lot single-family

Single-Family.description: Single Family Residential GP designation - 0.9-6.0 du/ac

Medium-Density.description: Medium Density Residential GP designation - 6.1-14.0 du/ac

Medium-High-Density.description: Medium-High Density Residential GP designation - 14.1-25.0 du/ac

High-Density.description: High Density Residential GP designation - 25.1+ du/ac

DCZD.description: Dublin Crossing Zoning District. Master-planned mixed-use community on former Camp Parks site. Density ranges from 6-60 du/ac depending on sub-area designation.

DDZD.description: Downtown Dublin Zoning District. Mixed-use downtown area near BART. Density ranges from 6.1-85 du/ac depending on sub-district (Village Parkway, Retail, Transit-Oriented).
